card.name: Linking words after a medical phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, during, by, to, including, a dash, a bracket) that come right after a drug, condition or patient group and lead into the next detail.

modes.label: Linking word after drug or condition
modes.description: Words like with, during, including, or have follow a drug, test or patient group.
modes.example: abnormal liver function tests<< during>> caspofungin acetate for

modes.label: Punctuation opening an aside
modes.description: A dash or bracket opens a cross-reference or added remark.
